verdict.rationale: Fellow provides the building blocks for an agent pipeline. Webhooks fire when an AI note is generated, a REST endpoint lists action items with filters and pagination, and the MCP server exposes action items to AI assistants. However, there is no evidence of native automations into Linear, Jira, or Asana, so filing items into a tracker requires custom glue code or an external agent. Missing for 10: native tracker integrations or automations, a documented action-item-created webhook event, a published OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end tracker sync.
